_comment: Fill every REPLACE value before running src/make_cards.py. hf_user / kaggle_user = your usernames.
author: Patricia Ornella Ngounou Tchuinteu
base_model: REPLACE (e.g. Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B: use the official Hub id)
one_line: A waste and sanitation model for Cameroon that sorts waste items, reads pickup requests in French, English and Pidgin, and computes compost and value estimates from local parameters.
training_steps: Waste sorting, pickup requests and compost calculations with exact labels
REPLACE: hygiene/sanitation documents turned into Q&A
limitations:
- Routes describe general good practice; local collection points differ by city and must be confirmed.
- Compost figures depend entirely on the parameters passed in the context.
- Pidgin spelling is not standardised.
how_made:
1. Python generators (in the GitHub repo) produced messages and tables with exact labels in fr/en/pcm.
2. A test set was split off and frozen before any upload (15% random + held-out templates, towns, items).
3. Training rows went through Adaption Adaptive Data; advisory rows were created with Forge from openly licensed documents.
4. `merge_adapted.py` dropped rows with broken JSON, wrong keys, duplicates or any overlap with the test set.
